title: Build with us
documentTitle: Build with us | Upload Your Build & Share Ideas | SUPUZZ
description: Join the SUPUZZ community: upload up to 5 photos of your build, write a play idea, or share a social link. Free to submit, reviewed before publishing.
intro: Share whatever you've built — any theme, any idea. Upload photos, write about it, or link your social post.
imageAlt: A parent and child building together with colorful SUPUZZ blocks

submit.title: Share your build
submit.body: Upload up to 5 photos, write a play idea or story, or share a link to your social post. We'll review it before publishing.

form.imageHint: Up to 5 images. JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
form.note: By submitting, you join the Play Club. No spam — unsubscribe anytime.
form.success: ✓ Thanks! We'll review your submission and may feature it.
form.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
form.requiredContent: Add a description, a photo or a social link.
form.invalidImage: Only JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF images are allowed.
form.maxImages: You can upload up to 5 images.

faq.a: Yes. Submitting your build is completely free and takes a minute.
No account needed. Just add your email so we can reach you about your submission.
We review your build, then feature the best ones in our newsletter and on our social channels. Nothing is published without review.
